parameters.query:
SELECT c.*, 
       COUNT(ct.id) as turn_count,
       a.name as agent_name,
       a.model_config
FROM conversations c
LEFT JOIN conversation_turns ct ON c.id = ct.conversation_id
LEFT JOIN agents a ON c.assigned_agent_id = a.id
WHERE c.status = 'completed'
  AND c.ended_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM long_term_memory ltm 
    WHERE ltm.metadata->>'conversation_id' = c.id::text
  )
GROUP BY c.id, a.name, a.model_config
HAVING COUNT(ct.id) >= 3;

parameters.query:
UPDATE agent_performance
SET total_calls = total_calls + 1,
    successful_resolutions = successful_resolutions + {{ $json.metadata.outcome === 'resolved' ? 1 : 0 }},
    escalations = escalations + {{ $json.metadata.wasEscalated ? 1 : 0 }},
    avg_satisfaction = (
      (avg_satisfaction * total_calls + {{ $json.metadata.satisfaction }}) / (total_calls + 1)
    ),
    avg_duration = (
      (avg_duration * total_calls + {{ $json.metadata.duration }}) / (total_calls + 1)
    ),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE agent_id = (
  SELECT id FROM agents WHERE name = '{{ $json.metadata.agent }}' LIMIT 1
)
  AND period_start >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days';
